ml-01.label: Prepared plan (recovery)
ml-01.content:
# Prepared plan (recovery for ml-01)
Goal: predict each customer's net spend (COMPLETED transactions) in the 90 days after a snapshot cutoff.
Read only from HOL_SANDBOX.SOURCE; write only to HOL_SANDBOX.P001; compute on HOL_EXAMPLE_WH.

Windows (data covers 2025-03-30 to 2026-09-30):
- Cutoffs: first day of each month, 2025-07-01 to 2026-07-01 (each has >= 90 days of prior history).
- Features: events strictly before the cutoff (recency, 30/90-day count and spend, category mix, segment).
- Label: net spend in [cutoff, cutoff + 90 days). Customers with no purchases get 0.
- Eligible: cutoff + 90 days <= 2026-10-01 (fully observed).
- Train: cutoffs 2025-07-01 .. 2026-01-01. Validation: 2026-04-01 (purges label windows overlapping train).
  Final holdout: 2026-05-01 .. 2026-07-01 (never used for tuning).
- Scoring: cutoff 2026-10-01, features only (no label yet).
Evaluation: MAE and RMSE versus a baseline that predicts trailing-90-day spend.
Registration: Model Registry in HOL_SANDBOX.P001, target WAREHOUSE, metrics + seed + date range.
Monitoring: historical holdout predictions with actuals; baseline = validation predictions.
Nothing provisions new compute pools, grants, or endpoints.

ml-02.label: Prepared skill (recovery)
ml-02.content:
---
name: hol-ml-review
description: Team modeling gates for the retail lab. Use before training, evaluating, registering or monitoring any model in HOL_SANDBOX.
---

# hol-ml-review

Use the bundled machine-learning skill for Snowflake ML APIs. This skill only adds team gates.

## Gates (check each; stop and report if one fails)
1. Fixed random seed; record dataset start/end dates and data version.
2. Features use only events before the snapshot cutoff; labels cover [cutoff, cutoff + 90 days) and are fully observed.
3. Temporal holdout with overlapping label windows purged. Fit preprocessing on training rows only. No IDs, future outcomes or label-window aggregates as predictors.
4. Compare a simple baseline with the candidate on MAE and RMSE. Never tune on the final holdout.
5. Register the exact feature signature, metrics and data metadata; verify warehouse inference.
6. Drift needs baseline data; performance needs ground truth. Report "pending" or "insufficient data" honestly.
7. Writes stay in HOL_SANDBOX.<PARTICIPANT_SCHEMA>. Stop before new compute, grants, deployment or external sharing.

## Output
A short checklist: gate, pass/fail, evidence (query or metric).

ml-03.label: Feature snapshot checkpoint (answer key)
ml-03.content:
-- Recovery checkpoint for ml-03: point-in-time customer snapshots.
-- Features use transactions strictly BEFORE CUTOFF_DATE; label = COMPLETED spend in [CUTOFF, CUTOFF + 90 days).
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE HOL_SANDBOX.P001.CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOTS AS
WITH cutoffs AS (
  SELECT DATEADD(MONTH, SEQ4(), '2025-07-01'::DATE) AS CUTOFF_DATE
  FROM TABLE(GENERATOR(ROWCOUNT => 16))          -- 2025-07-01 .. 2026-10-01
),
tx AS (
  SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, TRANSACTION_TIME, PRODUCT_CATEGORY, IFF(STATUS = 'COMPLETED', AMOUNT, 0) AS NET_AMOUNT
  FROM HOL_SANDBOX.SOURCE.TRANSACTIONS
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.SEGMENT, k.CUTOFF_DATE
  FROM HOL_SANDBOX.SOURCE.CUSTOMERS c CROSS JOIN cutoffs k
)
SELECT
  g.CUSTOMER_ID,
  g.CUTOFF_DATE::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS CUTOFF_TS,
  DATEADD(DAY, 90, g.CUTOFF_DATE)::TIMESTAMP_NTZ AS LABEL_END_TS,
  IFF(g.SEGMENT = 'PREMIUM', 1, 0) AS IS_PREMIUM,
  COALESCE(DATEDIFF(DAY, MAX(IFF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME < g.CUTOFF_DATE AND t.NET_AMOUNT > 0, t.TRANSACTION_TIME, NULL)), g.CUTOFF_DATE), 999) AS DAYS_SINCE_LAST,
  COUNT_IF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, g.CUTOFF_DATE) AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < g.CUTOFF_DATE AND t.NET_AMOUNT > 0) AS ORDERS_30D,
  COUNT_IF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, g.CUTOFF_DATE) AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < g.CUTOFF_DATE AND t.NET_AMOUNT > 0) AS ORDERS_90D,
  COALESCE(SUM(IFF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME >= DATEADD(DAY, -30, g.CUTOFF_DATE) AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < g.CUTOFF_DATE, t.NET_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS SPEND_30D,
  COALESCE(SUM(IFF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, g.CUTOFF_DATE) AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < g.CUTOFF_DATE, t.NET_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS SPEND_90D,
  COALESCE(SUM(IFF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME >= DATEADD(DAY, -90, g.CUTOFF_DATE) AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < g.CUTOFF_DATE AND t.PRODUCT_CATEGORY = 'Electronics', t.NET_AMOUNT, 0)), 0) AS ELECTRONICS_SPEND_90D,
  -- Label (NULL for the 2026-10-01 scoring cutoff, whose window is not observed yet)
  IFF(DATEADD(DAY, 90, g.CUTOFF_DATE) <= '2026-10-01'::DATE,
      COALESCE(SUM(IFF(t.TRANSACTION_TIME >= g.CUTOFF_DATE AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < DATEADD(DAY, 90, g.CUTOFF_DATE), t.NET_AMOUNT, 0)), 0),
      NULL) AS NEXT_90D_SPEND,
  CASE WHEN g.CUTOFF_DATE <= '2026-01-01' THEN 'TRAIN'
       WHEN g.CUTOFF_DATE = '2026-04-01' THEN 'VALIDATION'
       WHEN g.CUTOFF_DATE BETWEEN '2026-05-01' AND '2026-07-01' THEN 'HOLDOUT'
       WHEN g.CUTOFF_DATE = '2026-10-01' THEN 'SCORING'
       ELSE 'PURGED' END AS SPLIT
FROM grid g
LEFT JOIN tx t ON t.CUSTOMER_ID = g.CUSTOMER_ID AND t.TRANSACTION_TIME < DATEADD(DAY, 90, g.CUTOFF_DATE)
GROUP BY g.CUSTOMER_ID, g.SEGMENT, g.CUTOFF_DATE;

-- Checks
SELECT SPLIT, COUNT(*) AS ROWS_, MIN(CUTOFF_TS), MAX(CUTOFF_TS), COUNT_IF(NEXT_90D_SPEND = 0) AS ZERO_SPEND
FROM HOL_SANDBOX.P001.CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOTS GROUP BY SPLIT ORDER BY 2;

ml-04.label: Train, register and score checkpoint
ml-04.content:
"""Recovery checkpoint for ml-04 and ml-05. Run in Cortex Code Desktop's Python environment
with snowflake-ml-python installed, as role HOL_EXAMPLE_P001. Writes only to HOL_SANDBOX.P001."""
import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error, mean_squared_error
from snowflake.ml.registry import Registry
from snowflake.snowpark import Session

SEED = 42
FEATURES = ["IS_PREMIUM", "DAYS_SINCE_LAST", "ORDERS_30D", "ORDERS_90D",
            "SPEND_30D", "SPEND_90D", "ELECTRONICS_SPEND_90D"]
TARGET = "NEXT_90D_SPEND"

session = Session.builder.getOrCreate()
session.use_role("HOL_EXAMPLE_P001"); session.use_warehouse("HOL_EXAMPLE_WH")
session.use_schema("HOL_SANDBOX.P001")

df = session.table("HOL_SANDBOX.P001.CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOTS").to_pandas()
for c in FEATURES + [TARGET]:
    df[c] = df[c].astype(float)
train, val, hold = (df[df.SPLIT == s] for s in ("TRAIN", "VALIDATION", "HOLDOUT"))
print("rows train/val/holdout:", len(train), len(val), len(hold))

def score(y, p):
    return {"mae": float(mean_absolute_error(y, p)), "rmse": float(np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y, p)))}

# Baseline: next 90 days looks like the last 90 days.
base = {"validation": score(val[TARGET], val.SPEND_90D), "holdout": score(hold[TARGET], hold.SPEND_90D)}

model = GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=150, max_depth=3, learning_rate=0.05,
                                  subsample=0.8, random_state=SEED)
model.fit(train[FEATURES], train[TARGET])
cand = {"validation": score(val[TARGET], model.predict(val[FEATURES])),
        "holdout": score(hold[TARGET], model.predict(hold[FEATURES]))}
print("baseline:", base); print("candidate:", cand)

# ml-05: register and run warehouse inference through the registered version.
reg = Registry(session=session, database_name="HOL_SANDBOX", schema_name="P001")
mv = reg.log_model(model, model_name="NEXT_90D_SPEND_MODEL", version_name="V1",
                   sample_input_data=train[FEATURES].head(50), target_platforms=["WAREHOUSE"],
                   comment="Retail lab GBR, seed 42, data 2025-03-30..2026-09-30",
                   metrics={"seed": SEED, "data_start": "2025-03-30", "data_end": "2026-09-30",
                            "baseline": base, "candidate": cand, "features": FEATURES})

scoring = session.table("HOL_SANDBOX.P001.CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOTS").filter("SPLIT = 'SCORING'")
preds = mv.run(scoring.select(["CUSTOMER_ID", "CUTOFF_TS"] + FEATURES), function_name="predict")
preds.write.save_as_table("HOL_SANDBOX.P001.NEXT_90D_PREDICTIONS", mode="overwrite")
print(session.sql("""SELECT COUNT(*) N, COUNT_IF("output_feature_0" IS NOT NULL) NON_NULL,
                     ROUND(AVG("output_feature_0"),2) AVG_PRED FROM HOL_SANDBOX.P001.NEXT_90D_PREDICTIONS""").collect())

# ml-06 prep: historical monitor source (holdout, real predictions + actuals) and baseline (validation).
for split, name in (("HOLDOUT", "MONITOR_SOURCE"), ("VALIDATION", "MONITOR_BASELINE")):
    hist = session.table("HOL_SANDBOX.P001.CUSTOMER_SNAPSHOTS").filter(f"SPLIT = '{split}'")
    out = mv.run(hist.select(["CUSTOMER_ID", "CUTOFF_TS", TARGET] + FEATURES), function_name="predict")
    out.write.save_as_table(f"HOL_SANDBOX.P001.{name}", mode="overwrite")

ml-06.label: Model monitor reference (facilitator demo)
ml-06.content:
-- Recovery/reference for ml-06. Run after ml04_05_train_register.py created MONITOR_SOURCE/MONITOR_BASELINE.
-- Teaching thresholds (illustrative): PSI > 0.20; MAE > 1.20 x validation MAE.
CREATE MODEL MONITOR HOL_SANDBOX.P001.NEXT_90D_SPEND_MONITOR WITH
    MODEL = HOL_SANDBOX.P001.NEXT_90D_SPEND_MODEL
    VERSION = 'V1'
    FUNCTION = 'predict'
    SOURCE = HOL_SANDBOX.P001.MONITOR_SOURCE
    BASELINE = HOL_SANDBOX.P001.MONITOR_BASELINE
    WAREHOUSE = HOL_EXAMPLE_WH
    REFRESH_INTERVAL = '1 day'
    AGGREGATION_WINDOW = '1 day'
    TIMESTAMP_COLUMN = CUTOFF_TS
    ID_COLUMNS = ('CUSTOMER_ID')
    PREDICTION_SCORE_COLUMNS = ('"output_feature_0"')
    ACTUAL_SCORE_COLUMNS = ('NEXT_90D_SPEND');

-- Performance per daily window (one window per holdout cutoff: 2026-05-01, 06-01, 07-01).
SELECT EVENT_TIMESTAMP, METRIC_NAME, ROUND(METRIC_VALUE, 2) AS VALUE, COUNT_USED
FROM TABLE(MODEL_MONITOR_PERFORMANCE_METRIC('HOL_SANDBOX.P001.NEXT_90D_SPEND_MONITOR', 'MAE', '1 DAY',
     '2026-04-30'::TIMESTAMP_TZ, '2026-07-02'::TIMESTAMP_TZ));

-- Drift of the 90-day spend feature against the validation baseline.
SELECT EVENT_TIMESTAMP, ROUND(METRIC_VALUE, 3) AS PSI
FROM TABLE(MODEL_MONITOR_DRIFT_METRIC('HOL_SANDBOX.P001.NEXT_90D_SPEND_MONITOR', 'POPULATION_STABILITY_INDEX',
     'SPEND_90D', '1 DAY', '2026-04-30'::TIMESTAMP_TZ, '2026-07-02'::TIMESTAMP_TZ));
-- A new monitor can show no rows until it refreshes: report "pending", then use the rehearsed reference monitor.
